newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wharf Cable worth HK$10-16 bln, CEO says.
newsitem.headline: Wharf Cable worth HK$10-16 bln, CEO says.

text.p: Hong Kong's cable television network Wharf Cable, a unit of Wharf Holdings Ltd, is worth between HK$10 billion and HK$16 billion, its chief executive Stephen Ng said on Monday.
Ng told a telecoms conference his valuation was loosely based on the recent purchase of Videotron Holdings Plc by Cable & Wireless.
Ng said Videotron, a cable television company, had roughly 250,000 subscribers from a potential customer base of 600,000 British homes wired for the service.
On the valuation of 2,500 pounds per subscriber for Videotron, Wharf Cable, which has a similar business, could use the same valuation, he said.
"We would suggest that it is in the vicinity of 10 to 15 or 16 billion (Hong Kong dollars)," said Ng.
Wharf Cable will have around 300,000 subscribers by the end of this year, Ng added.
